author_instruction: Organize only Survey, Idea, and ExperimentDesign evidence. Preserve DESIGN_ONLY status; do not claim observed conversion, differentiation efficiency, tissue repair, clinical benefit, cell-product safety, or patient outcome.
core_conclusion: Cell fate is stable because regulatory, epigenetic, lineage-history, and niche constraints reinforce one another, but selected contexts can be reprogrammed; credible evidence must prove provenance, multimodal identity, stability, function, and safety separately.
